auto.yourInformationMayBeTransferred: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
auto.weMayUpdateThisPrivacy: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
auto.allProductsAndServicesOffered: All products and services offered on Mithilakart are subject to availability. We reserve the right to limit quantities, discontinue products, or refuse service at our discretion. Prices are subject to change without notice. Product descriptions and images are provided for convenience and may not be entirely accurate.
auto.byPlacingAnOrderYou: By placing an order, you make an offer to purchase products at the listed price. We reserve the right to accept or reject your order. auto.deliveryTimesAreEstimatesAnd: Delivery times are estimates and may vary. We are not responsible for delays caused by third-party carriers or circumstances beyond our control. Risk of loss passes to you upon delivery to the carrier.
auto.ourReturnPolicyAllowsReturns: Our return policy allows returns within 10 days of delivery for eligible products. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and in resalable condition. auto.theseTermsShallBeGoverned: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Mumbai, India.
auto.atMithilakartWeAreCommitted2: At Mithilakart, we are committed to delivering your orders quickly and safely. This shipping policy outlines our delivery process, timelines, and charges to help you understand what to expect when you shop with us.
auto.deliveryTimelinesAreEstimatesAnd: Delivery timelines are estimates and may vary due to weather conditions, festivals, strikes, or other unforeseen circumstances. We'll keep you updated via SMS and email.

auto.atMithilakartWeAreCommitted3: At Mithilakart, we are committed to completely satisfying you with your purchase. This policy outlines our cancellation and return procedures to ensure a smooth and hassle-free experience.
auto.youCanCancelYourOrder: You can cancel your order anytime before it is shipped. Once the order is shipped, cancellation is not possible, but you can return the product after delivery.
